tagline: Pragmatic Senior Developer using Lovable for rapid full-stack scaffolding
description: A professional coder who hates 'boring setup work' and uses AI to generate the first 70% of a project before ejecting to a local IDE.
rationale: Hacker News and G2 reviews show developers use Lovable to 'scaffold projects rapidly' and then transition to Cursor or VS Code for the final 30%.
Elena faces the pain of repetitive boilerplate (Supabase setup, Auth, UI components); Lovable's GitHub sync and clean React/TypeScript output solve this 'setup friction'.
Retaining this persona is essential to combat the '70% problem' perception; they provide the technical validation needed to move Lovable beyond a 'toy' status into a professional tool.
